subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Ray was __cynical__ about love.
solution:
The correct answer is: **pessimistic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cynical"** means believing that people are motivated by self-interest; distrustful of human sincerity or integrity. (निंदक)

 
 
• **Example: **He was cynical about the politician's promises, suspecting they were just empty words.
 
 
 
• **"Pessimistic"** refers to tending to see the worst aspect of things or believe that the worst will happen. (निराशावादी)
 
 
• **Example: **Her pessimistic outlook made it hard for her to enjoy the good things in life.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that **"cynical" **is synonymous with **"pessimistic"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Prolific** (उत्पादक): Producing much fruit or foliage or many offspring.

 
 
• **Example:** The prolific writer published several books each year.
 
 
 
• **Obese** (मोटा): Grossly fat or overweight.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor advised the obese patient to adopt a healthier lifestyle.
 
 
 
• **Trusting** (विश्वासी): Showing or tending to have a belief in a person's honesty or sincerity; not suspicious.
 
 
• **Example:** She had a trusting nature, always believing in the good in people.
